title: FIGS Announces Date of Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Earnings Release, Conference Call and Webcast
summary: FIGS, Inc. (NYSE: FIGS), the global leading healthcare apparel brand dedicated to improving the lives of healthcare professionals, today announced it will release its fourth quarter and full year 2025 financial results on Thursday, February 26, 2026, after U.S. markets close. FIGS management will host a conference call that day at 2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET to discuss its financial and business results and outlook. Prior to the call, FIGS will publish a fourth quarter and full year 2025 financial highlights presentation on its investor relations website at https://ir.wearfigs.com/financials/quarterly-results/default.aspx .
